name: modernize-ci-and-release
title: Modernize CI and Release workflows
description: Make GitHub Actions the strict multi-platform merge and formal-release authority with pinned runners/actions, minimum permissions, reproducible toolchains, and a fail-closed ten-asset transaction.
creator: project-owner
notes: Automatic CI/Labeler and the unsigned Release transaction are implemented through PR #6 and exact-main CI. Exact-main preflights 31238817378, 31241064177, and 31251654600 failed closed before aggregation or publication. The D118 engineering remediation is implemented and locally verified: Windows Installer Automation now sits behind one schema-driven query module and native x64/ARM64 Required fixture, while runner/container metadata uses documented runner context plus observed container facts. Formal Release remains NO-GO until the remediation PR/main CI and a five-target preflight succeed; immutable v0.3.0, public Release, attestations, and independent closeout evidence remain pending.
